12. Discount Grocery Stores.

We have a store locally that sells dented and dinged cans, and buys food off damaged tractor trailers.

Aldi is another wonderful discount grocery store.

13. Chest Freezers Are Awesome!

Anything you see on managers special, milk, juice, bread, turkey burger, some types of fruits vegetables, are great to stock up on while they are on sale.

Freezing milk or bread does not effect the taste when thawed.

I prefer using frozen everything when possible as things in the refrigerator tend to spoil if not used quickly.
